title: Encarnados: los alumnos rojos por dentro
description: docs/castle.md § Encarnados. One group every other day, a room of the castle's floor or one of the night's groups, comes red from inside with a red halo: more PV, harder blows, and beaten it lets go of an Eco de luz (one every other day, six in a game). Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.night = { g: () => window.gerard.game, s: () => window.gerard.game.nightStreet, n: 50, frozen: false, clear() { const s = this.s(); s.pupils.splice(0); s.pointed = false; s.marching = false; delete s.learned; delete s.fresh; }, make(kind, dx, dz, more = {}) { const me = this.g().position, at = { x: me.x + dx, z: me.z + dz }; const p = { id: 'night-' + (++this.n) + '-1', group: 1, kind, position: at, facing: 0, mode: 'patrol', patrol: [{ x: Math.round(at.x), z: Math.round(at.z) }], next: 0, timer: 0, known: { x: me.x, z: me.z }, look: 0, seeing: false, stuck: 0, ...more }; this.s().pupils.push(p); return p; }, far(p) { const me = this.g().position; return Math.hypot(p.position.x - me.x, p.position.z - me.z); }, freezeWhen(test) { this.frozen = false; const tick = () => { let ok = false; try { ok = test(this.s()); } catch {} if (ok) { this.g().setPaused(true); this.frozen = true; } else requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }, stage(x, z) { this.frozen = false; this.g().setPaused(false); this.s().tier = { ...this.s().tier, perTrain: 0 }; this.clear(); this.g().standAt({ x, z }); } }
